messages:
maria (ml-eng): quick sanity check — onboarding 7B quantized model on 2x GPUs shows weird p95 spikes when NVLink is available. baseline PCIe run looks stable, SXM with NVLink has higher tails. anyone seen KV-cache crosslink flares like this?

alex (ml-infra): can you paste the minimal repro and numbers? which model, seq len, batch, and region?

maria (ml-eng): repro: 2x H100 in same node, exported quantized 4-bit, serving config: --gpus 0,1 --batch 8 --max_tokens 64. seq=128 typical.
command: ```./run_infer --model ./runs/7b-q4 --gpus 0,1 --batch 8 --tokens 64 --profile```

results (summary):
PCIe box (no NVLink): p50=36ms, p95=120ms, throughput=220 req/s
SXM box (NVLink active): p50=34ms, p95=420ms, throughput=300 req/s

So avg throughput higher on SXM but tails are bad and cause timeouts in our canary (p95 > SLA). logs show bursts of cross-GPU memcpy around tail events.

jordan (bench): that pattern usually means intermittent kernel fallback or NUMA-memory thrash when KV fills and we start syncing caches across GPUs. did you pin cpus/memory to GPU numa nodes?

maria (ml-eng): not yet. default job scheduler left it to the kernel.

jordan (bench): try this quick patch:
```bash
# bind mem+cpus to NUMA node of GPU 0/1 (example, adapt node id)
numactl --physcpubind=0-15 --membind=0 
python serve.py --gpus 0,1 --batch 8 --tokens 64
```
Also set CUDA peer access explicitly:
```python
for i in gpus: torch.cuda.device(i); torch.cuda.enable_peer_access(j)
```

taylor (platform): another common cause — runtime falling back to different GEMM kernel for larger effective sequence when KV cache syncs. check runtime config: kernel_preference and gemm_backends. On our H100 nodes we saw a cuBLASLt->fallback to reference when cutlass kernels are misselected; forcing cutlass for int8/4bit path helped.

maria (ml-eng): tried both. ran with numactl + force kernel=cutlass in runtime config. small follow-up numbers:
SXM + numactl + cutlass: p50=35ms, p95=130ms, throughput=295 req/s
(that p95 drop fixed most of tail)

maria (ml-eng): attaching tiny ascii timeline (p95 windows) — PCIe steady, SXM before fix big spikes, after fix aligned with PCIe.

alex (ml-infra): nice. can you file a short infra ticket to make NUMA pinning default for multi-gpu runs on same-node deployments? and add kernel_preference="cutlass" to H100 profiles in model catalog for quantized 4-bit?

maria (ml-eng): will do. also note this only showed up on eu-west1 H100 pool, us-west H100 nodes didn't exhibit the same spikes — likely BIOS/kernel build differences and NVLink topology. worth adding a smoke across clouds.

deploy-bot: quick-ci-run #1892349999 completed: benchmark-smoke (eng-ml) — 5/5 tests passed, latency-regression check OK

alex (ml-infra): action items: 1) enable NUMA pinning by default for multi-gpu same-node flows (infra ticket), 2) add cutlass-pref profile for H100 quantized paths (catalog change), 3) add a small smoke test across regions to catch kernel/fallback differences. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria (ml-eng): thanks — i'll open the tickets and paste repro + logs. saved us from a mid-rollout SLA hit.
